motion_and_interactions.tactile_feedback: Active scale transform (scale-95 to scale-98) on product cards, category tabs, and payment keys
motion_and_interactions.cart_item_enter: Animate slide-in-right and fade-in when adding items to cart
motion_and_interactions.modal_animation: Framer Motion ease-out scale and opacity transition (0.15s)
motion_and_interactions.status_pulse: Pulse dot indicator for real-time kitchen orders and offline sync status

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g. data-testid='pos-product-card-123', data-testid='cart-checkout-button', data-testid='online-status-badge', data-testid='quick-cash-20'
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_shortcuts: Number keys for quick numpad, Enter for Pay, Esc for Clear/Close Modal, Space for Search
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: All normal text contrast > 4.5:1 on dark surfaces, active CTA text strictly high-contrast dark on light amber button

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is applied by default via class='dark' on the root element or document element.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for drop-down menus, select triggers, or header overlays; use semi-opaque `#16181E` with backdrop blur.
Implement data-testid attributes on all interactive elements: buttons, category tabs, cart items, payment triggers, and search inputs.
Use Lucide React icons for clean POS controls (e.g., ShoppingBag, CreditCard, Coffee, Layers, DollarSign, Wifi, WifiOff, RefreshCw, User, Settings, Shield).
Keep touch areas large (minimum 44x44px for buttons, 110px height for product cards) for quick counter tapping.
Make sure code is written in React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) standard without TypeScript syntax issues.
